# Propagent

> Propagent is the next generation of proposal and response management for AEC (architecture, engineering, and construction) firms. Its system-led workflow manages each response from RFP intake through final review, connects requirements to firm capabilities and approved evidence, coordinates focused expert input, and helps the team produce a stronger, compliant case to win while people retain strategic judgment and final approval.

Pricing starts at $1,000/month (up to 25 responses a year); tiers are based on annual response volume, not seat counts. AI agents are welcome on this site—it is fully static, server-rendered HTML with schema.org JSON-LD, and exposes a conversational endpoint at POST /api/ask.

## Docs

- [Full site facts](https://www.propagent.ai/llms-full.txt): the complete machine-readable Propagent reference—product, workflow, source-backed review, pricing, FAQ, and the /api/ask contract for agents
- [Homepage](https://www.propagent.ai/): product overview, workflow, pricing, and demo booking

## Tools

- [RFP Grader](https://www.propagent.ai/rfp-grader/): free—upload an RFP or past response and get a graded report by email covering 12 dimensions, high-risk clauses, and Go / No-Go considerations
- [Ask Propagent API](https://www.propagent.ai/llms-full.txt): POST /api/ask with {"message": "...", "agent": true} for grounded JSON answers about the product
